content:
ops-bot: INCIDENT_ALERT: gpu-rt-22 reporting repeated container restarts. Reason: GPU OOM during prefill (long-context). Containers restarted: 4 in last 5m. sample_error: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY. ticket: INC-1795123456

jordan (oncall): on it. I see 502s increasing on hosted-api route /v1/chat. Root cause looks tied to prefill on long prompts.

maya (sre): metrics: 12% error rate for prefill-stage, 480 req/s total, ~60 req/s hitting long-window models. Memory spike aligns at prefill token ~150k.

devon (eng-runtime): any CUDA traces?

ops-bot: attached trace snippet -> "kernel 17: cuMemAlloc failed: out of memory"; Cuda stack shows allocation attempt during kv-cache apply.

jordan (oncall): initial mitigation: enable routing fallback for long-context requests to smaller-quantized variant (model=redwood-lite-q4). Can someone flip route? @devon?

devon (eng-runtime): doing a quick route override: set route long-context -> redwood-lite-q4, ttl=30m. Pushing now.

engbot: route change applied by devon at 1795123510.

nina (cust-success): heads-up: customers showing errors: AcmePayments (high), DocuFlow (medium). Acme is reporting 15% failures on invoice generation flows. Preparing customer note.

leo (infra): I'll cordon gpu-rt-22 and drain pods to prevent further noisy restarts. Starting cordon now.

maya (sre): additional hot-mitigation: enable prefill token cap at gateway: max_prefill_tokens=8192 for the next 20m. This should prevent extremely long prefill allocations. Can ops flip that?

jordan (oncall): confirmed. Applying cap at gateway config. ops-bot: annotate with reason "prefill-oom emergency cap".

ops-bot: gateway config updated: max_prefill_tokens=8192. All new requests over cap will 413.1 -> respond 413 code with guidance.

devon (eng-runtime): investigating runtime: seems kv-cache allocation path doesn't respect soft cap on massive contexts for quantized kernels. I'll push a temp guard to abort prefill earlier. ETA 25m for hotpatch.

maya (sre): good. Meanwhile, leo: after drain, please restart the affected node's driver (nvidia-driver restart) and recycle pods one-by-one to clear GPU state.

leo (infra): driver restart scheduled. Restarting pods as they come back up.

nina (cust-success): drafting customer-impact blurb: "We're seeing an intermittent error impacting long-document generation for a small subset of customers. Engineers are actively mitigating by routing long requests to a smaller model and applying a temporary token cap. We'll follow up with timeline once runtime patch lands." Send review?

jordan (oncall): +1 send. Include recommended workaround: chunking long documents or using embeddings+rerank.

devon (eng-runtime): pushed hotpatch to guard prefill alloc path (abort if allocation > 10GB). Rollout to canary; monitoring.

engbot: hotpatch deployed to canary pool at 1795123700.

maya (sre): canary metrics look stable for 3m. No OOMs observed. Gradual rollout to 20% then full.

jordan (oncall): status update to page: mitigations applied: route override to lite model, gateway prefill cap, node cordon + driver restart, runtime hotpatch rolling. Customer impact: limited to long-context flows for ~2% of traffic overall, but AcmePayments saw 15% failures.

nina (cust-success): sent customer note to Acme and DocuFlow with workaround. They'll reply if they need SLA credit.

jordan (oncall): keeping incident open until runtime patch fully rolled and node stable. Will handoff to devon/maya for postmortem. If anything changes ping @jordan. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: INCIDENT_STATE: mitigated -> monitoring. time_to_mitigate: 8m (initial actions).

devon (eng-runtime): filing follow-up PR to add a prefill safety budget and a model-router auto-fallback when prefill exceeds safe threshold. Assigning self + maya for postmortem.

jordan (oncall): thanks team. Handoff complete. Last checked at 1795123856.
